title: Excel: import and export
intro: Get the whole fleet in an Excel workbook, or add machines and the history of an old logbook in one go.
exportText: A workbook with three sheets: machines, logbook (every entry) and due items.
importText: Same columns as the export. “Machines” sheet: code and type are required. “Logbook” sheet: date, machine (code), entry and title. A machine already present (same code) is updated; an entry already in the logbook is not added twice.

summary.newMachines: {count, plural, one {# new machine} other {# new machines}}
summary.updated: {count, plural, one {# machine updated} other {# machines updated}}
summary.entries: {count, plural, one {# entry to add} other {# entries to add}}
summary.duplicates: {count, plural, one {# entry already in the logbook (skipped)} other {# entries already in the logbook (skipped)}}
summary.nothing: Nothing to import in this file.

problems: {count, plural, one {# row skipped} other {# rows skipped}}

reason.dupCode: code “{value}” appears twice in the file

done: Import complete: {machines, plural, one {# machine} other {# machines}}, {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}.
errRead: This file is not a readable Excel workbook (.xlsx).
errPartial: Import stopped ({message}). Everything before that is saved.
